citation.description: Ticket description (Completion evidence 2026-09-06): per-worktree git status now runs through a bounded helper (timeout, gtimeout, or macOS-safe perl alarm) and nonzero/timeout status is classified STATUS_UNKNOWN / KEEP. criteria.criterion: AC2 [non-codebase] A lock whose holder is dead is detected as stale and does not permanently disable the GC. Prove both branches: a live holder still blocks, a dead holder does not.
